message.content:
**Answer**

At the **59th Annual Grammy Awards** (held on February 12, 2017) the top‑honor for albums—commonly referred to as “Album of the Year” (sometimes colloquially called “Best Album”)—was awarded to **Beyoncé** for her record **“Lemonade.”**

> • **Winner:** Beyoncé  
> • **Winning album:** *Lemonade*  
> • **Ceremony:** 59th Annual Grammy Awards (Feb 12, 2017)

*(There isn’t a distinct category titled exactly “Best Album”; the highest accolade for an entire release is the “Album of the Year” prize.)*

If you’re looking for a different genre-specific “Best Album” award (for example, Best Rock Album, Best R&B Album, etc.), let me know and I’ll look it up!
